Nation Pays Homage To Martyred Intellectuals
2013-12-15T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/nation-pays-homage-to-martyred-intellectuals-2552

Projonmo ’71, a platform of children of the martyred freedom fighters and intellectuals of the Liberation War, lays one at the memorial. Photo: Star, BSS

Common people stream to Mirpur Martyred Intellectuals Memorial to pay their tributes. Photo: Star, BSS

A green-and-red-clad kid, also wearing a sticker and headband of the national flag, joins the human sea at Rayerbazar. Photo: Star, BSS

Children of Kendrio Khelaghar Asar stage a mock mass killing of intellectuals there. Photo: Star, BSS

An old man propped up on the crutch sees photos of the atrocities by the Pakistani army in 1971 at Rayerbazar. Photo: Star, BSS

President Abdul Hamid and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina place wreaths at the Mirpur memorial. Photo: Star, BSS

Leader of the Opposition and BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia and party leaders paying their homage there. Photo: Star, BSS

Vice Chancellor of Dhaka University Prof AAMS Arefin Siddique lays a wreath at the memorial. Photo: Star, BSS
